# Halberd — Platform Acquisition (Industrials)

- **Type:** platform control buyout in industrials; TEV ~**$220M** at ~9x EBITDA.
- **Sponsor:** [Kate Sinclair](../profile/principal.md), with
  [Michael Brennan](../people/michael-brennan.md) leading the debt financing and
  [James Foster](../people/james-foster.md) leading diligence.
- **Status:** **AT RISK** (updated 2026-07-15). The **QoE flagged ~$4M of unsupported EBITDA
  add-backs**, which cuts real EBITDA and inflates the effective entry multiple. This
  **supersedes** the "LOI signed / on track" read from the 2026-06-05 partners meeting. Kate must
  decide whether to **re-trade** the price down or **walk**.

## The blocker (multi-hop)
- The gating item is the **QoE re-review**, owned by [James Foster](../people/james-foster.md):
  he is re-cutting the model with the add-backs stripped and pressure-testing the go-forward
  EBITDA. Until that lands, the debt commitment [Michael Brennan](../people/michael-brennan.md)
  arranged is unstable (leverage was sized off the inflated EBITDA).
- [William Stonehaven](../people/william-stonehaven.md) is skeptical of add-back-heavy deals and
  will scrutinize this at IC.

## Open items
- Review James Foster's revised QoE analysis — see [commitments](../commitments.md).
- Halberd engagement letter owed back to [Carol Nguyen](../people/carol-nguyen.md).
- Re-trade vs. walk decision pending the revised numbers.
